name: Sportradar
tagline: Enterprise sports data APIs for live scores, stats, odds, and betting content across leagues worldwide
description: Sportradar provides enterprise-grade sports data APIs covering live scores, play-by-play, statistics, odds, and media content for major leagues and sports worldwide. Access is typically via API keys through partner or trial onboarding rather than fully open self-serve signup; confirm current trial and commercial terms on developer.sportradar.com.

auth.details: API key via query parameter api_key or Authorization header; trial and commercial access through Sportradar developer portal (not fully anonymous self-serve).

pricing.paid_plans: Commercial enterprise pricing; trial access available via developer portal — contact sales for production plans.

use_cases: get NBA regular-season game schedule for a year
fetch live or final scores for a specific game
pull team and player statistics for a league
retrieve odds or betting markets for an event
list standings for a sports league
